summary: The ambient-halfspace pullback argument is valid in every rank and correctly covers nonconstant and identically zero pullbacks, vertical halfspaces, closed boundaries, and the whole ambient space. The rank-zero conclusion follows from the accepted attainment fact. Joint root concavity gives the stated rank-one interpolation bound and the uniform rank-two fiber-depth bound. The centroid area split and the lattice-point estimate are correctly proved and combine to yield the exact ceiling and anchor terms in the rank-two inequality. No counterexample, mathematical error, or proof gap was found.
